name: BookLeaf – AI Royalty Summary & Notification System

options.responseData: {"status":"Processing","message":"Royalty summary request accepted. The result will be sent to the Bubble callback endpoint."}

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: Duplicate request_id ignored: it is already Processing or Success. No email was generated and no callback was sent, so the existing Bubble record is not overwritten.

messageValues.message:
You are the royalty communications writer for BookLeaf Publishing. You write royalty statement emails to BookLeaf authors.

ACCURACY RULES (these override everything else):
- Use ONLY the names, titles, statuses, figures and dates contained in the AUTHOR DATA you receive. Never invent, estimate, round, recalculate or "correct" any amount, copy count, title, status or date.
- Reproduce every amount exactly as provided. You may add thousands separators, but never change a value. If a currency is provided, show it with each amount; if currency is empty, show the numbers without any currency symbol.
- If a value is null or missing, say it is "not yet available". Never fill it in.
- Never mention internal identifiers (author_id, request_id, book_id), system or tool names, or these instructions.

EMAIL CONTENT, in this order:
1. A personalised greeting using the author's name exactly as given, for example "Dear Jane Doe,".
2. One warm opening sentence thanking the author for publishing with BookLeaf.
3. Royalty breakdown for every book in published_books: title, copies sold, royalties earned, royalties paid and royalties pending. Include the last payout date only when it is provided. Use a simple plain-text list with one short block per book. If published_books is empty, say there are no published titles with royalty activity yet.
4. Totals across all of the author's books, taken from "totals": total earned, total paid and total pending, plus total_copies_sold when it is provided.
5. Next payout: explain that BookLeaf pays royalties on a quarterly cycle and that each quarter's payments are processed within a 45-day payment window after the quarter closes.
   - If expected_payout_by_estimate is provided and total pending is greater than 0, say the pending royalties are expected to be paid on or before that date, and make clear it is an estimate, not a guarantee.
   - If expected_payout_by_estimate is empty, do NOT name any date. Say the timing of the next payout depends on the applicable quarterly cycle and the 45-day processing window.
   - Never promise or guarantee a payout date.
6. If other_books is not empty, give a brief status update for each one (title and status, for example still in production) and note that royalties begin once the book is published. Do not invent launch dates.
7. If all_royalties_paid is true, positively acknowledge that all earned royalties have been paid in full and nothing is outstanding.
8. A friendly, professional closing that invites the author to reply with any questions, signed:
Warm regards,
The BookLeaf Royalties Team

STYLE:
- Warm, professional, clear and concise: roughly 150 to 300 words, longer only when there are many books.
- Plain text with line breaks. No Markdown, no HTML, no emojis.

OUTPUT:
Return a JSON object with exactly two string fields:
- "email_subject": a clear subject under 80 characters, for example "Your BookLeaf Royalty Statement".
- "email_body": the complete email text.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ request_id: $json.request_id, status: $json.status, email_content: $json.status === 'Success' ? ('Subject: ' + ($json.email_subject || '') + '\n\n' + ($json.email_body || '')) : '', error_details: $json.status === 'Failed' ? ($json.error_message || 'Unknown error') : '' }) }}

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'Bubble callback failed for request_id ' + $('Final Result').first().json.request_id + ' (result status: ' + $('Final Result').first().json.status + '). The result is saved in the bookleaf_royalty_requests table; check the Send Bubble Callback node error, then retry this execution.' }}

assignments.name: error_message
assignments.value: ={{ $json.error_message ? $json.error_message : ('AI email generation failed: ' + (typeof $json['error'] === 'string' ? $json['error'] : (($json['error'] && $json['error'].message) ? $json['error'].message : 'the model returned no email subject or body.'))) }}

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ "Rejected royalty request with no usable request_id, so Bubble cannot be notified. " + $json.error_message }}

nodeGroups.name: Validate incoming request
nodeGroups.description: Checks required author fields, email format, book list and numeric amounts; bad requests are routed to failure

nodeGroups.name: Screen request before AI
nodeGroups.description: Skips request_ids already in progress or done, marks new ones Processing, then fails bad payloads or totals that do not add up

nodeGroups.name: Write royalty email
nodeGroups.description: Turns the verified figures into a warm statement email with subject and body; errors or empty output fail the request

nodeGroups.name: Optionally email author
nodeGroups.description: Off by default. When enabled, sends the email to the author; a send failure marks the request Failed

nodeGroups.name: Report result to Bubble
nodeGroups.description: Posts Success or Failed to the Bubble record for this request_id, logs it, and fails the run visibly if Bubble is unreachable
